answer_text: Yes. Use the Allowlisting Processes and URLs for the Cato Client to whitelist the domain (badexfil-cdn.net) across endpoints. This feature allows you to add FQDNs or URLs to an allowlist that applies to all security endpoint software and solutions. See the Allowlisting Processes and URLs for the Cato Client article (and the Preparing to install the Cato Client page that references it) for the exact steps.
